nodes.description: Public string state variable 'name' of DogePorn, set to 'Doge Porn' in the constructor.
Public string state variable 'symbol' of DogePorn, set to 'pDoge' in the constructor.
Public uint8 state variable 'decimals', set to 18 in the constructor.
Public uint256 '_totalSupply' holding the total token supply, set in the constructor.
Mapping(address => uint) 'balances' storing token balances of holders.
Nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) 'allowed' storing ERC20 allowances.
DogePorn constructor: sets name, symbol, decimals, _totalSupply and mints the whole supply to msg.sender.
totalSupply() returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] using unchecked raw subtraction.
balanceOf(address tokenOwner) returns balances[tokenOwner].
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approve(address spender, uint tokens) writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and emits Approval.
transfer(address to, uint tokens) moves tokens from msg.sender using safeSub/safeAdd.
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens) moves tokens and debits allowance without checking the caller's allowance.
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b) with overflow require(c >= a).
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b) with require(b <= a).
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b) with overflow require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b) with require(b > 0).
msg.sender: externally controlled caller address used as balance key, allowance owner and mint recipient.
approve: allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens, unrestricted external allowance overwrite.
transfer: balances[msg.sender] = safeSub(balances[msg.sender], tokens), state debit dependent on msg.sender.
transfer: balances[to] = safeAdd(balances[to], tokens), state credit to an arbitrary recipient.
transferFrom: balances[from] = safeSub(balances[from], tokens), debits an arbitrary account.
transferFrom: allowed[from][msg.sender] = safeSub(allowed[from][msg.sender], tokens), allowance debit without any allowance check.
transferFrom: balances[to] = safeAdd(balances[to], tokens), state credit to an arbitrary recipient.
safeAdd: raw addition c = a + b guarded only by require(c >= a).
safeSub: raw subtraction c = a - b guarded by require(b <= a).
safeMul: raw multiplication c = a * b guarded by require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
safeDiv: division c = a / b guarded by require(b > 0).
totalSupply: return _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] performs an unchecked raw subtraction (potential underflow).
